e1: 129 is the Health and Welfare Counseling Center, advising on health services, catastrophic medical expense support, basic livelihood assistance, and other programs.
General counseling: weekdays 09:00–18:00. Emergency welfare, welfare gaps, abuse, and mental health crisis counseling: 24 hours. Calls are free nationwide.
For urgent rescue or medical emergencies, call 119 first. Ask about eligibility and application steps.
e2: 119 is the emergency number for fire, rescue, and ambulance services.
119 emergency medical control centers also provide first-aid guidance and emergency medical advice.
From a safe place, give your location, situation, and the number of people needing help.
e3: 112 is the police emergency number for crimes, threats, and other urgent situations.
The 112 reporting portal supports phone, text, recorded audio, and video reports.
Give your location and situation. You can report by text if speaking is difficult.
e4: 1339 is the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency call center for infectious disease information, prevention, and reporting.
Open 24 hours every day. Domestic calls are free; international calling charges apply from abroad.
Ask about infectious diseases, prevention, vaccination, and reporting procedures.
e5: 1577-2584 connects to prosecution victim support offices.
Victims and their families can ask about case procedures and outcomes, recovery counseling, and referrals to other support organizations.
For urgent crimes or threats to your safety, call 112 first.
e6: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs Consular Safety Call Center handles overseas incident reports and safety advice 24 hours every day.
From abroad, dial +82-2-3210-0404. The official free-calling app is also available with an internet connection.
Ask the counselor about emergency interpretation and local response options.
e7: 109 is the suicide prevention hotline. Suicide prevention counseling was consolidated under 109 on January 1, 2024.
Counseling is available 24 hours. Other mental health counseling numbers continue to provide their own services.
If someone's life or physical safety is in immediate danger, call 119 or 112 first.
e8: 111 is the National Intelligence Service reporting number for national security-related crimes and activities.
Reports include North Korean spies and associates, international crime, terrorism, industrial and defense spying, foreign espionage, and cyberattacks.
Calls to 111 without an area code are free. Text #0111 and official online reporting are also available.
e9: 113 is the police counter-espionage reporting number for espionage, industrial technology leaks, terrorism, and related reports.
For urgent crimes or threats to your safety, call 112.
e10: 1338 is the military resident reporting number listed in local government reporting guidance.
Report suspicious military-related situations. For urgent crimes or rescue, call 112 or 119.
e14: 128 is a reporting channel for environmental pollution.
Prepare the location, time, and type of pollution. From a mobile phone, dial the area code followed by 128.
e15: 1399 connects to the National Food Safety Information Service for unsafe or substandard food reports.
Calls are free nationwide. Counseling: weekdays 09:00–18:00. Prepare product or business information and evidence such as photos.
Use the relevant dedicated channels for medicines, narcotics, medical devices, or cosmetics.
c1: 1588-2504 is the expressway call center for traffic information, tolls, and expressway inquiries.

On Korea Expressway Corporation roads, emergency towing moves eligible vehicles at risk of secondary accidents to the nearest safety area. This does not mean further transport to a repair shop is free.
Move to safety first, then give the road location and vehicle situation. Confirm eligibility and towing limits.
c3: For injuries or rescue, request help from 119 first.
Give the accident location and current dangers. Check separate police procedures for accident certificates and routine inquiries.
c4: Call 119 if a traffic accident causes injuries or requires rescue.
Give the location, injuries, and number of people. Follow first-aid instructions.
c6: For the Automobile Compensation Promotion Institute government compensation program, call 1544-0049 and select 1.
Ask about statutory eligibility and application requirements for injuries involving uninsured, hit-and-run, or stolen vehicles, and falling cargo from unidentified vehicles.
Ask about eligibility and required documents. Not all accidents or property damage qualify.
c7: 110 provides government inquiry guidance in areas including transport, construction, finance, insurance, and policing.
Free phone counseling is available 24 hours every day. Request emergency response through 112 or 119.
c8: The police LOST112 portal supports lost property reporting and searches.
Report or search on LOST112, or call 182. Also check the transport operator's own lost property center.
c9: 1544-7788 is KORAIL's customer center for train travel and tickets.
Check KORAIL's guidance or the phone menu for hours, lost property, and refund procedures.
h1: 1588-1300 is the postal customer service number for inquiries about mail forwarding after moving.
Apply through a post office or the online post office, and check service conditions, duration, and fees.
Check forwarding conditions, duration, and fees. Update bank, card, and insurance addresses separately.
h2: 1661-2642 is the Korea Environment Corporation's Neighbor Noise Center.
It provides phone counseling and on-site noise measurement for apartment residents nationwide. Hours: weekdays 09:00–18:00, excluding weekends and public holidays.
Binding mediation or resolution is not guaranteed. Ask about eligibility and procedures.
h3: 1566-9009 is the Korea Housing & Urban Guarantee Corporation integrated call center.
Ask about rental deposit return guarantees, rental loans, and Housing and Urban Fund products. Hours: weekdays 09:00–18:00.
Check guarantee eligibility and coverage. Rental fraud victim support uses a separate channel.
h5: 123 is KEPCO's electrical inquiry and fault reporting number, available 24 hours every day.
From a mobile phone, dial the area code followed by 123. Calls are charged.
For urgent hazards such as fire or electric shock, call 119 first.
h6: The responsible office for water supply, outages, and leaks depends on your local water supplier.
If K-water does not serve your area, contact the local water authority. Ask 110 if you do not know the responsible office.
h7: 131 is the Korea Meteorological Administration weather call center, staffed 24 hours every day.
Nationwide calls use local call rates, with no separate additional charge.
Ask about typhoons, heavy rain, heat waves, cold spells, and other weather alerts.
l1: 132 is the Korea Legal Aid Corporation's number for legal advice and litigation support eligibility.
Calling charges are paid by the caller, separately from counseling fees.
l2: 1577-1000 is the National Health Insurance Service counseling number for premiums, benefits, and reimbursement.
l3: 1332 is the Financial Supervisory Service counseling number for financial products and harm from illegal financial activity.
For financial products or illegal finance, call 1332. For phishing counseling and tips, call 1394. For urgent crime, call 112.
l4: 1394 is the police integrated financial phishing reporting number operated by the Telecommunications Financial Fraud Response Team.
End a suspected phishing call, then contact 1394 for advice or reporting. For immediate crime or threats, call 112.
l5: 118 is the Korea Internet & Security Agency counseling number for personal data leaks and privacy infringement.
Prepare information and evidence about the data leak or infringement.
l7: 126 is the National Tax Service counseling number for income tax, VAT, and other national taxes.
Hours: weekdays 09:00–18:00; tax evasion reports: 24 hours.
Calling charges are paid by the caller.
l9: 118 is the Korea Internet & Security Agency counseling number for ransomware, hacking, and phishing websites.
Urgent hacking and virus incidents: 24 hours every day. General counseling: weekdays 09:00–18:00.
118 advises on internet security incidents. For urgent crime, call 112; for integrated phishing reports, call 1394.
l10: 1301 is the Supreme Prosecutors' Office call center for prosecution cases, fines, and related inquiries.
Hours: weekdays 09:00–18:00; the prosecution situation office handles calls afterward.
Calling charges are paid by the caller.
l11: 1372 is the Consumer Counseling Center number for transaction, contract, and consumer harm inquiries.
Prepare contracts, transaction records, and other relevant documents.
l12: 1600-5500 is the Credit Counseling & Recovery Service number for debt adjustment programs and applications.
l13: 1397 is the Korea Inclusive Finance Agency counseling number for policy-backed finance products and support.
Calls are free, with charges paid by the recipient.
l14: 1331 is the National Human Rights Commission counseling number for human rights violations, discrimination, and complaints.

f2: 117 is the police school violence reporting center.

f3: 1366 provides emergency counseling and support referrals for violence against women.

f5: 1345 is the Ministry of Justice Immigration Contact Center for visa, residency, and immigration advice.

f6: 1388 provides counseling for young people and guardians through the Korea Youth Counseling & Welfare Institute and Youth Counseling 1388.
f7: 1355 is the National Pension Service counseling number for enrollment, payments, and pension benefits.
f8: 1577-1389 connects to national and regional elder protection agencies for abuse reporting and counseling.

f9: 182 provides police guidance on missing person reporting and prevention.

d4: 118 is the Korea Internet & Security Agency spam reporting and counseling number.
